fields.Name: Artifact Block Frozen
fields.Description: A live MJ block in a Document, Presentation, or Spreadsheet artifact was frozen into a static snapshot (recording FrozenByUserID, Timestamp, and SnapshotContentHash).

fields.Name: Artifact Connected Drive Sync
fields.Description: An artifact version was pushed to or pulled from a linked external Connected Drive (OneDrive, SharePoint, or Google Drive), recording ExternalFileID, VersionNumber, and ETag.

fields.Name: Artifact Exported
fields.Description: An artifact was exported to an external file format (.docx, .pptx, .xlsx, or PDF).

fields.Name: Artifact Permission Changed
fields.Description: Sharing permissions on an artifact were granted, updated, or revoked.

fields.Name: Artifact Guest Share Link
fields.Description: A Frozen-only expiring read-only external guest share link was created, resolved, or revoked for an artifact version.
